name: EbyAds Skill Lite
focus: eBay General 成交費率／Priority 點擊成本雙模式試算與歸因檢查
english: Offline eBay General CPS and Priority CPC planning, fee-base economics and attribution review.

general: 確認 listing site 與 General 功能
提供實際廣告計費基礎：不可直接使用淨收入替代
比較廣告費率、目標利潤與費率上限
核對目前站點歸因規則及扣費明細
priority: 確認 Priority CPC 功能
整理提供的搜尋詞與 listing 條件
用訂單貢獻及使用者 CVR 情境估算經濟 CPC 上限
分開閱讀 Direct／Halo 歸因，勿重複加總

notes: General is cost-per-sale; Priority is cost-per-click. General effective spend/click is not a CPC bid.
Ad fee base can include shipping, taxes and other applicable amounts. User must provide fee_base_per_order; never substitute order_revenue.
Official current attribution page and some older overview pages differ. For affected sites General can use a click by any buyer; no buyer click-order conversion rate is inferred.
Ad-rate ceilings are economic scenarios, not accepted UI ranges or recommendations to use maximum rates.
checklist: 確認站點與最新 General 歸因規則
核對成交價、運費、稅及其他計費金額
平台銷售費另計，不與廣告費重複扣除
Priority 不套用成交百分比計費邏輯
